description: Boeing 720 (originally a 720, often called a 707) registered VT-ERS to Continental Aviation in 1991, force-landed at Nagpur in 1991 and abandoned beside the runway for 24 years; towed to the Nagpur Flying Club area of the airport on 29 Sep 2015 (Simple Flying 2023 citing Nagpur Today; warbirds.in; TOI 2015). Derelict hulk, not a curated display, inside airport premises; NDTV ran a retrospective in Apr 2026 but its current condition/existence is not independently confirmed for 2025-26.
